name: USDC / Silicon Valley Bank depeg (March 10-13, 2023)
speed: USDC -13% in ~4 hours (disclosure 03:11 UTC -> low 07:16 UTC Mar 11); full episode peg-break-to-repeg ~65 hours; BTC swung -11% then +20% within the same 5 days
summary: 10-13 марта 2023: у Circle $3.3B резервов застряло в SVB — USDC $1→$0.87 за ~4 часа (redemption закрыт на выходные), DAI $0.885, FRAX $0.875, USDT — с премией. Пег восстановлен за ~65 часов после гарантий ФРС. КАНОНИЧЕСКИЙ сценарий для книги, где кэш — тот же USDC: выход «в кэш» НЕ снижает peg-экспозицию, а продажа на дне фиксирует убыток, который пассив вернул за 3 дня. Книга SPA на 2026-08: aave_v3 40% / pendle (PT_USDC) 20% / maple 15% / morpho_steakhouse 15% / кэш USDC 10%.

timeline.event: Silvergate Capital announces voluntary liquidation (its SEN crypto settlement network had already been discontinued Mar 3) — crypto USD banking rails begin failing; BTC/ETH sell off.
SVB Financial discloses $1.8B loss on a $21B bond portfolio sale; a run on Silicon Valley Bank begins. Circle initiates wires Thursday to pull its deposits — they do not clear.
California DFPI closes Silicon Valley Bank; FDIC receivership — largest US bank failure since 2008. BTC falls below $20k (~$19,670, one-month low); >$70B wiped off crypto market cap in 24h.

Circle tweets (6:50pm ET) it is 'operating normally'; SVB is one of six banking partners holding the cash portion of reserves; USDC already wobbling ~$0.98-0.99 on DEXs as traders flee the Curve 3pool.

Record DEX volumes: Uniswap ~$11.9B/24h (all-time high), Curve ~$6-7B (all-time high, 3pool ~80% of it). Borrowers rush to repay dollar-denominated debt with discounted stablecoins: >$2B USDC + ~$300M DAI repaid on Aave/Compound on Saturday alone; debtors 'saved' ~$100M ($84.1M USDC, $20.8M DAI per Flipside). ~3.4k liquidations on Aave v2/v3 seize ~$24M collateral (86% USDC); Aave realizes ~$300k insolvencies over the weekend.

Circle blog commits to covering any reserve shortfall 'using corporate resources, involving external capital if necessary'. USDC oscillates roughly $0.90-0.97 through the weekend; arbitrageurs accumulate (a wallet linked to Justin Sun reportedly nets >$3M); MEV extraction hits records — one sandwich of a panic 3CRV dump nets a bot $2.045M profit while the seller receives $0.05 USDT for ~$2M.

MakerDAO files emergency executive: USDC PSM daily mint cap 950M -> 250M, swap fee 0% -> 1%, LP-token debt ceilings to 0. Passes governance in ~2h but the 48h GSM delay means it executes only Monday Mar 13 — after the turmoil is over. DAI tracks USDC down because >50% of collateral was USDC-linked (PSM).

Circle discloses (10:11pm ET Fri) that $3.3B of ~$40B USDC reserves (~8%) remain stuck at SVB because Thursday's wires were not processed. Secondary-market run accelerates; primary redemptions effectively closed for the weekend (banking rails shut).

Coinbase tweets (10:41pm ET) it is pausing USDC:USD conversions over the weekend 'while banks are closed'; Binance had suspended USDC auto-conversion to BUSD (~01:52 UTC). Off-ramp closure deepens panic.

Gauntlet tells Aave Guardian to be ready to pause (07:03 UTC), then at 09:19 UTC formally recommends pausing ALL Aave v2/v3 markets (v3 e-mode assumed stablecoin correlation with only 1% liquidation bonus). Aave Guardian declines a full pause.

USDC bottoms ~$0.87-0.88 (Kraken low $0.877 at 07:16 UTC; ~$0.87 'by 2am ET'; Fed note cites trough ~$0.86-0.87). DAI hits all-time low ~$0.885-0.897, FRAX ~$0.874-0.885; USDT trades at a premium. Curve 3pool drained of USDT (<7% share vs USDC and DAI >45% each); median gas jumps from ~23 to ~304 gwei (+1,200%).

Aave Guardian freezes USDC, USDT, DAI, FRAX, MAI on Aave v3 Avalanche and sets LTV to 0 (no new positions; liquidations continue). Separately, Compound v2's Pause Guardian halts USDC supply — Compound v2 hard-codes USDC at $1.00 (85.5% collateral factor), so a persistent depeg below ~$0.875 would have created insolvencies; borrowing continues.

Circle CEO Allaire: '100% of deposits from SVB are secure and will be available at banking open tomorrow'; $3.3B moving to BNY Mellon, new mint/redeem settlement partner Cross River Bank; automated minting/redemption to resume Monday.

Treasury/Fed/FDIC joint statement (6:15pm EDT): all SVB depositors made whole with full access Monday Mar 13; Signature Bank (Signet rail) closed the same day under identical guarantee; Fed launches BTFP facility. USDC gaps up toward $0.97-0.99.

US banks open; Circle resumes 1:1 redemptions and USDC repegs (~$0.993-1.00 on major indices during the day; fully at $1 by Mar 13 evening/Mar 14). DAI and FRAX repeg in tandem. BTC rallies 18-20% off Friday's low to >$24,000; ETH +15% to ~$1,700.

Slow-burn aftermath: repeg does not stop the exit — Circle burns ~$1.6B USDC on Fri Mar 10 alone, ~$1B net redemptions by Sat, ~$6B net redemptions by Mar 21; USDC circulation falls >10% within weeks (mcap $43.5B pre-event, sliding toward ~$33B by summer 2023). MakerDAO's emergency PSM parameters finally execute Mar 13 — after the crisis.

defi_impact.bridges_chains: no chain halts or bridge failures; contagion spread cross-chain via bridged USDC pricing (hence the Avalanche freeze)

causes.primary: Classic bank-run transmission into a stablecoin: SVB's failure trapped $3.3B (~8%) of USDC's cash reserves, disclosed Friday night AFTER the primary redemption window had closed for the weekend, so all price discovery happened in secondary markets with no arbitrage anchor.
secondary: Weekend banking gap: mint/redeem rails (and Coinbase/Binance conversion desks) shut Fri night-Mon morning, converting a solvency question (~3% worst-case haircut) into a 13% price dislocation
Concentration of crypto USD rails: Silvergate/SEN already dead, Signature/Signet killed Sunday — settlement infrastructure failing simultaneously
DeFi's structural USDC dependence: DAI (>50% USDC-linked collateral via PSM) and FRAX (USDC AMOs) mechanically imported the depeg
Hard-coded $1 assumptions: Compound v2 oracle, Frax collateral pricing, Maker PSM 1:1 swaps — protocols could not see or price the depeg
Thin weekend DEX liquidity + panic selling: Curve 3pool drained of USDT, gas x13, record MEV extraction punishing forced sellers
causes.mechanism: SVB bond-portfolio losses -> depositor run -> FDIC receivership Fri Mar 10 -> Circle's $3.3B wire fails -> 10:11pm ET disclosure -> secondary-market run on USDC with primary redemptions closed -> USDC $0.87-0.88 -> mechanical contagion to USDC-collateralized stables (DAI, FRAX, MIM) -> DEX pool imbalance, gas/MEV spike, lending-market liquidations and guardian freezes -> flight to USDT/BTC/ETH -> Fed/Treasury/FDIC full-depositor backstop Sun 6:15pm EDT + Circle corporate guarantee -> redemptions reopen Monday -> arbitrage closes the discount within hours.

contagion: Circle discloses $3.3B/~8% of USDC reserves trapped (Mar 11 03:11 UTC)
Primary redemptions closed for weekend + Coinbase/Binance conversion pauses (03:41 UTC)
USDC secondary-market run -> $0.87-0.88 low (07:16 UTC Mar 11)
USDC-backed stables depeg: DAI ~$0.885 (PSM), FRAX ~$0.875, MIM wobbles
Curve 3pool drained of USDT (<7% share); record DEX volume (Uniswap $11.9B, Curve $6-7B); gas 23->304 gwei; record MEV sandwiches
Lending-market stress: 3.4k Aave liquidations ($24M collateral, 86% USDC), ~$300k Aave insolvencies, Compound v2 USDC supply paused (hard-coded $1), Aave v3 Avalanche stables frozen 13:00 UTC
$2B+ discounted-stablecoin debt repayments on Aave/Compound; flight to USDT/BTC/ETH
Fed/Treasury/FDIC backstop (Mar 12 22:15 UTC) + Signature Bank closure (Signet rail lost) + Circle guarantee
Redemptions reopen Mar 13 -> repeg -> BTC/ETH rally +15-20%
Slow-burn: ~$6B net USDC redemptions by Mar 21, circulation -10%+, months-long USDC market-share bleed to USDT

recovery.time_to_recover: Peg: ~65h from break to restoration — Circle resumed 1:1 redemptions Mon Mar 13 and USDC printed $0.993-1.00 that day, fully $1.00 by Mar 13 evening/Mar 14. DAI/FRAX repegged in tandem. Trust: much slower — ~$6B net redemptions by Mar 21, circulation down >10% in weeks and USDC market cap slid from $43.5B toward ~$33B by mid-2023; market share ceded to USDT took over a year to begin recovering.
recovery.notes: Recovery was exogenous: the Fed/Treasury/FDIC full-depositor backstop (Mar 12, 22:15 UTC) plus Circle's corporate guarantee, NOT market self-correction. The counterfactual without the Sunday backstop — a permanent ~3% reserve haircut plus Monday-morning redemption run — is the harsher stress-test variant. Buyers at $0.87-0.88 earned ~14% in 48h (a Justin Sun-linked wallet reportedly >$3M); MEV bots earned record extraction from panic sellers.

(7) Aave $24M/3.4k liquidations from Aave's own blog (Kaiko data); Aave ~$300k realized insolvency from Gauntlet's governance post — these are protocol/risk-manager self-reports. spa_relevance.summary: THE canonical scenario for this portfolio: every non-cash position is USDC-denominated, and in March 2023 the 'risk-free' leg itself broke 13% for ~3 days while exit rails (primary redemption, CEX conversion, cheap gas) all closed simultaneously.

positions.aave_v3_usdc: Direct hit through THREE channels: (1) mark-to-market — aUSDC is worth what USDC is worth, -12-13% at the trough; (2) market mechanics — $2B+ repayment wave crashed utilization and supply APY overnight (APY collapse channel), while liquidations of stable-stable e-mode positions generated ~$300k insolvencies socializable to suppliers; (3) governance — on Avalanche the market was frozen (LTV->0) intra-crisis; a guardian pause (recommended by Gauntlet!) would have blocked even exits. Withdrawal itself kept working on mainnet — but only because the Guardian declined the pause.
positions.pendle_pt: PT is a fixed-rate claim on an underlying yield position (e.g. aUSDC): at maturity it inherits the full USDC depeg 1:1, and pre-maturity it trades WORSE — PT secondary price = discounted underlying x panic yield spike, in an AMM whose liquidity evaporates exactly when needed. Exiting a PT on Mar 11 meant selling into a thin pool at 300 gwei with MEV bots harvesting every large stable swap (see the $2M->$0.05 sandwich). Model: PT price shock >= underlying depeg, plus a liquidity/slippage penalty of several percent.
positions.maple: Maple pools lend USDC to institutional borrowers with lockups/withdrawal queues — the NAV silently marks -13% with USDC and there is NO intra-crisis exit at all (queue-gated). Also second-order counterparty channel: March 2023 hit exactly the market-maker borrower base Maple lends to, and Maple's own cash-management product held T-bills via banking rails of the kind that were failing. A 3-day depeg is survivable; the scenario variant where the backstop does NOT come Sunday night is the one that produces borrower defaults and real bad debt here.
positions.morpho_steakhouse_usdc: Inherits the underlying money-market behavior (in 2023 terms, Morpho-Aave/Compound; today, Morpho Blue markets). Critical detail from this event: if any underlying market prices USDC like Compound v2 did (hard-coded $1), the vault share price will NOT reflect the depeg — NAV looks flat while real value is -13%, and whoever redeems first exits at fantasy NAV at the expense of remaining LPs. Also curator-action risk: guardians froze/paused markets with hours' notice.
positions.cash_10pct: Only if 'cash' means actual fiat off-rails. If 'cash' is idle USDC, it depegs identically — 2023 proved the cash bucket is the SAME risk, not a hedge. USDT or T-bill exposure would have been the actual hedge that weekend.

unpriced_if_usdc_hardcoded_1: The entire -13% mark-to-market on ~90% of the portfolio (worst-case realized loss if forced to liquidate at the trough: roughly -$11k on $90k deployed)
Primary redemption closure: USDC->USD convertibility is NOT continuous — it has weekend/banking-hours gaps; any model assuming instant $1 exit is wrong 2 days out of 7
Correlated depeg of 'diversifiers': DAI/FRAX fell WITH USDC (rotating into them mid-crisis was not a hedge)

Protocol-level freezes: markets can be frozen (no new positions) or paused (no exits) mid-crisis by guardians within hours — rebalancing plans that assume protocols are always withdrawable fail exactly when needed
Gas/MEV exit tax: 13x gas and record sandwich extraction mean small-size emergency exits lose additional 1-5%+; a $100k portfolio's rebalance costs explode
